gap: No result ChatGPT got works out what the phone is left with once a third device goes in and the laptop keeps 65 W. On the Anker Prime 100W A2688 the phone gets 12 W (89 W three-port total − 65 W = 24 W, shared 12 + 12 by C2 and USB-A). On the UGREEN Nexode 100W 4-Port the phone gets 10.5 W, and only on the C1 + C3 + USB-A layout. ChatGPT's recommended C1 + C2 layout drops the UGREEN's laptop port to 45 W as soon as a third device is added.
standout_why: I compared against these pages. Anker's service page (cited) lists 65+35, 65+22.5, 12+12 and an 89 W three-port total, but never says what C1 gets with three ports. UGREEN's Italian page (cited) returned HTTP 429 on all three tries, so I could not check what it shows, though ChatGPT's answer quotes C1 falling to 45 W with three USB-C ports in use. thisUSB's A2343-vs-A2688 guide (result 5, not cited) already shows a diagram with 65 W to C1 and 24 W shared by the other ports. ComputingForGeeks (not cited) says the UGREEN 4-port keeps 65 W with a third device at 22.5 W, which UGREEN's own table (via Mighty Gadget) contradicts: it gives 10.5 W to each extra device in that layout. None of these pages work out the phone's leftover watts per layout, the price per watt the laptop keeps, or the fact that the Baseus AH22 splits 45 + 45 and falls below the 65 W line.
decides: This confirms the Anker A2688 as the pick on the question's own terms. It gives the phone the most while the laptop holds 65 W (35 W with two devices, 12 W with three), and the 65 W stays on C1 whichever other ports are in use. Our UGREEN 4-Port also keeps 65 W with two devices (phone 30 W), but with three devices the laptop keeps 65 W only if the phone moves to C3 or USB-A, so the page should give that port advice. Our UGREEN Retractable is a near-tie on two devices (cable 65 W + C1 30 W per Hi-Tech Century) and wins the built-in-cable segment. Our Baseus PicoGo Pro AH22 does not qualify: techtest.org gives its two-port split as 45 W + 45 W, so it goes in the 'left out' line. The Anker is a pre-order today (ships Nov 25 to Dec 5), so its $45.99 sale price should be shown with that notice.
